system_prompt_style.note: prompt_templates.py exists in file tree but its contents are not in the evidence; paper says 'given a structured prompt that integrates the current evidence with disease-specific knowledge' (Sec. 4.1.1), suggesting templated, but mechanism not shown.

env_context_strategy.note: Not a repository/environment harness; paper describes a shared memory with static disease-symptom knowledge injected into prompts (Sec. 4), which does not map to the value list. Source files not in evidence.

context_compaction.note: No history-processing code in evidence; only file names available.

observation_format.evidence_quote: thePatient Agentresponds based on the patient profile.
observation_format.note: Patient agent responses are text; inferred from prose.

tool_call_format.note: No tool-calling; actions are symptom inquiries selected from RL-sampled candidates. Parser code not in evidence.

tool_count.note: No tool registry in evidence; the system does not appear to expose tools.

edit_primitive.note: No file-editing domain; tool definitions not in evidence.

protocol_standardization.note: requirements.txt contents not in evidence, so no grep possible.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: each consultation round proceeds through four steps
loop_primitives.note: Each round runs fixed stages (diagnosis, candidate actions, inquiry selection, patient response) iterated up to L turns; closest value fixed_pipeline.

planning_granularity.note: Inquiry agent follows predefined reasoning strategies; no plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: four collaborative agents operating over a shared memory to execute the consultation workflow
multi_agent_topology.note: Fixed hand-off sequence of Diagnosis, Policy (RL), Inquiry, Patient agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: All agents operate over a sharedmemory
delegation_mechanism.note: Closest value; agents hand control in fixed order over shared memory.

human_in_loop.note: The patient is simulated by an LLM agent. Run loop code (inference.py) not in evidence.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: a dy-namic component that is continuously updated with observed symptoms and diagnostic confidence

long_term_memory.note: Static prior knowledge (empirical_knowledge.json) is dataset-derived rather than cross-run memory. Paper proposes a memory tree only as future work (Sec. 6).

retry_policy.note: Candidate-action regeneration is step-level: 'requests thePolicy Agentto regenerate a new set of actions' (Sec. 4.3). This is not task-level retry.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: terminates either when the turn limit is reached or when the termination action is sampled by thePolicy Agent.
termination_condition.note: L=10 turns (Sec. 5.4). The termination action comes from the RL policy rather than the LLM.

execution_isolation.note: The simulated environment (patient_environment.py) executes no external actions; its code is not in the evidence.

permission_model.note: The action mask constrains RL actions but is not an authorization mechanism.

eval_hooks.note: Datasets DXY/GMD/CMD with test splits ship in the repo, and inference evaluates accuracy.

target_domain.evidence_quote: LLM-Based Medical Consultation via Multi-Agent Collaboration

open_source.note: The file tree contains no LICENSE file; the code is public.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: it is currently incompatible with API-based LLMs and must be deployed with locally hosted models.
model_agnostic.note: Supports several local backbones (Qwen2.5, LLaMA3) but requires trained adapters; closest value no.

primary_artifact.note: Research code accompanying the paper arXiv:2505.18630.

first_release_date.note: No tag or first-commit date is in the evidence. The paper v2 date is 10 Oct 2025, but the v1 date is not given.

pinned_version.note: Untagged main branch commit, and the hash is short; the full hash is not in the evidence. The evidence header gives no file line, so line 1 is a placeholder, not an opened line (rule 7).

stars.note: The star count comes from the evidence bundle header, not from a gh api call; no retrieval date is given. Line 1 is a placeholder.
